meta.title: 二手车商自述：讲诚信的人，为什么被行业淘汰

scenes.title_en: Entering the trade and going viral
scenes.context: 讲者自述入行经历：从车老会打工到做车商自媒体，三个月涨粉到50万。
sentences: 我曾经是一位二手车行业的从业者，2018年5月30号入行。
I used to work in the used-car trade, starting on May 30, 2018.
从业者：industry practitioner
我们做起了当时很多车商想都没想过的东西，叫做车商自媒体。
We built something most dealers had never dreamed of — a car-dealer media channel.
自媒体：media channel
短短三个月，粉丝量一下就涨到了50多万。
In just three months, followers exploded to over half a million.
涨到50多万：explode to 500K+
paraphrase: 个人影响力是议价筹码
Personal reach is a bargaining chip.
From behind the scenes to the front of the camera.
scenes.speak: I used to work in the used-car trade, starting on May 30, 2018. We built something most dealers had never dreamed of — a car-dealer media channel. In just three months, followers exploded to over half a million.

scenes.title_en: Refusing junk cars and buying in
scenes.context: 讲者拒绝推销问题车，2020年入股20%后淘汰问题车，销量变好利润却更少。
sentences: 当时车老会有些产品，是车况一言难尽的车，故障灯清了亮、亮了清。
The shop carried cars with questionable condition — the warning lights kept cycling on and off.
故障灯：warning light
收这种车，它的利润要远远高于精品车。
Sourcing these cars pays far better than clean ones.
利润远高于：pays far better
从入股车行开始，车行就开始走上坡路，但是钱却比之前挣得少得多。
After I bought in, the shop got on track — but we made far less money than before.
走上坡路：get on track
paraphrase: 拒绝的底气来自不可替代性
The courage to refuse comes from being irreplaceable.
The cost of staying clean starts to show.
scenes.speak: The shop carried cars with questionable condition — the warning lights kept cycling on and off. Sourcing these cars pays far better than clean ones. After I bought in, the shop got on track — but we made far less money than before.

scenes.title_en: The industry truth and walking away
scenes.context: 讲者用4个月9000元盈利和考察发现，得出行业无信用的结论，并选择退出。
sentences: 4个月做下来，整个公司的盈利是9000块钱。
Over four months, the whole company earned 9,000 yuan in total.
总盈利：total profit
但凡车行做得大的，现在依然瑕疵车当精品车在卖，依然调表。
Every big dealer still sells flawed cars as premium and still rolls back odometers.
调表：roll back the odometer
当一切道德摆在生存面前的时候，真的显得非常渺小。
When morality is set against survival, it looks so very, very small.
道德摆在生存面前：morality vs survival
paraphrase: Playing by the rules became a disadvantage.
Walking away is also a stand.
scenes.speak: Over four months, the whole company earned 9,000 yuan in total. Every big dealer still sells flawed cars as premium and still rolls back odometers. When morality is set against survival, it looks so very, very small.

practice: The whole industry has no trust left.
I'd rather walk away than play along.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The warning lights clear and light again.
✓ 地道说法：The warning lights keep cycling on and off.
清了亮、亮了清→cycling on and off。
✕ 直译腔：The profit rate of this kind of car is much higher.
✓ 地道说法：Sourcing these cars pays far better.
✕ 直译腔：Morality is very small in front of survival.
✓ 地道说法：Morality looks tiny next to survival.
✕ 直译腔：I am a person with a high moral ideal.
✓ 地道说法：I'm an idealist at heart.
shifts: 以为诚信经营必然走远
看到生存压力下道德的重量
把行业乱象归因于劣根性
用系统视角看结构性问题
把退出当坚守底线的选择
